summary: This class manages the state machine for duplicant approach behaviors in Oxygen Not Included. It defines states for approaching a target, interacting with it, and handling failures.  It uses a `GameStateMachine` framework, common in ONI modding for managing entity behaviors.  The states include approach, interaction (with pre, loop, and post animation stages), and failure.  Target acquisition and reservation are handled within the state machine.

keyMethods.name: InitializeStates
keyMethods.description: Initializes the states of the approach behavior state machine.  Sets up transitions between approach, interact, and failure states, including event handling (e.g., `GameHashes.ApproachableTargetChanged`), animation playback, and resource reservation/unreservation.  Uses callbacks to access and modify the state machine instance and its associated data.

parameters.name: default_state
parameters.description: The default state of the state machine.

keyMethods.name: Reserve
keyMethods.description: Reserves the target using a specified tag if a reserveTag is defined in the Def.  This is crucial for preventing resource conflicts between duplicants.

parameters.name: smi
parameters.description: The instance of the state machine.

keyMethods.name: Unreserve
keyMethods.description: Unreserves the target using a specified tag if a reserveTag is defined and a valid target exists. This cleans up after a successful or failed approach.

parameters.name: smi
parameters.description: The instance of the state machine.

keyMethods.name: RefreshTarget
keyMethods.description: Refreshes the target GameObject for the state machine. If the target is null, transitions to the failure state. Updates target offsets.

parameters.name: smi
parameters.description: The instance of the state machine.

keyProperties.name: interact
keyProperties.description: The interaction state of the state machine. Contains nested states for pre-interaction, looping interaction, and post-interaction animations.

keyProperties.name: behaviourComplete
keyProperties.description: The state indicating the behaviour is complete.

keyProperties.name: approach
keyProperties.description: The state representing the approach phase towards the target.

keyProperties.name: failure
keyProperties.description: The failure state of the state machine.

keyProperties.name: self
keyProperties.description: Target parameter representing the self (the actor approaching).

keyProperties.name: target
keyProperties.description: Target parameter representing the target the actor is approaching.

keyProperties.name: Def
keyProperties.description: Configuration class for the approach behavior.  Contains tags (monitorId, behaviourTag, reserveTag) and animation names (preAnim, loopAnim, pstAnim).  Provides parameters to customize approach behavior for different entities or actions.

keyProperties.name: InteractState
keyProperties.description: Represents the interaction phase, further broken down into pre, loop, and post animation states.

keyProperties.name: Instance
keyProperties.description: Game instance of the state machine.  Handles interaction with game objects and monitors.  Contains methods for retrieving and setting the associated monitor (likely for managing approach behavior). It also includes a `targetOffsets` property, likely used for precision targeting.
